candidate.loop: Explore the forest and snowy ruins, collect two magical flowers, and return them to the healer to complete the quest.

requirements.source: The entire adventure takes place on ONE continuous map.
requirements.meaning: Single connected level with no separate zone loading.

requirements.source: Half of the world is a lush magical forest full of trees, flowers, small ponds, and wooden pathways. The other half is a frozen landscape with snowy trees, slippery ice, and ancient ruins.
requirements.meaning: World features distinct forest and dark/garden/snow biomes.

requirements.source: Walking on ice should feel slippery, while walking through the forest should have normal movement.
requirements.meaning: Icy terrain applies reduced friction for slippery movement.

requirements.source: A healer living in the forest asks me to retrieve two magical flowers from the snowy ruins.
requirements.meaning: Quest to collect specific items from a designated area.

requirements.source: The game ends when I return the flowers to the healer.
requirements.meaning: Quest completion and item delivery ends the game successfully.
Exclusion of all combat elements and enemies.
